design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (gift_registry_services, env_0061), revised in rework round 2.
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}: the root registry_ext_credit_redemption and the prerequisite registry_ext_gift_return_credit take 4 factors each.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: registry_ext_completion_redemption (redeem_completion_discount_f7189a88) and registry_ext_missed_rewards_accrual (book_rewards_accrual_4ec6fd92). Claimed here: registry_ext_credit_redemption (subject registry_credit_use, apply_registry_credit_10dfa5f2, owner=user — the registrant paying with her own registry credit) and registry_ext_gift_return_credit (subject registry_return_credit, book_return_credit_c9fb6682, owner=agent). The two tasks together cover all four extended policies and tools, pairwise disjoint. The credit use event lies outside the difficulty's claim list but inside the registry category (audit G-11: observation, exclusivity intact).
[Why a good test] The caller wants one payment: registry credit on her blender order. The credit drawn is bounded by the registry credit available, which is short until the agent reads the prerequisite sentence, finds the received vacuum return without a credit entry and books it with its own four-factor credit (label fee, restocking percent with an open-box grace, insured surcharge, marginal restocking taper). Then the bonus arithmetic on the amount still to be paid bites. Computation-document-only readers get 650.00 (credit drawn) and 880.00 (return credit); skipping the return credit gives 120.00; gold is 732.80 then 528.92.
[Problem-tree card] Root registry_ext_credit_redemption <- registry_ext_gift_return_credit. Edge value_input, gate available, form state, policy_source "Registry credit is not applied to a purchase until every registry gift the registrant has returned and the store has received stands on the registry as a registry credit entry." Four-point test: negated direction ("not ... until"), as a release of money is stated at a desk; record-visible state (return records in received status vs credit entries carrying their return id); no tool, id or code token; scope = received returns of registry gifts. Exactly one write of this difficulty creates a registry_return_credit entry: book_return_credit_c9fb6682. Opening evidence: the vacuum return is in received status, the vacuum purchase is returned (returned_date 2026-10-09), and no credit entry carries the return id; registry_credit_balance 120.00. Deletion run: skipping step 9 -> credit_amount 120.00 instead of 528.92. Order: step 9 then step 11. Owner=user problem: paying with her own registry credit. The persona never names the vacuum, its return or its credit; the tools check nothing.
[Base-invariant card] registry_gift_returns.registry_return_deadline (time): anchor registries.event_date 2026-09-01, Housewarming window 90 days, class deadline Electronics 30 days from completed 2026-08-23 = 2026-09-22, later-of = 2026-11-30, inclusive; authorized 2026-10-06 in time; 2026-12-01 would fail. one_credit_per_return (dedup): the only credit entry carries the towel return id; the vacuum return id appears only on a rewards reversal. registry_credit_rules / registry_agg_per_registry_balances: policy scope; registry in completion status, one registry.
[Business-object card] Return credit target: the vacuum return (mail prepaid label, changed_mind, opened_unused, received) on guest purchase 40621376 (Miele Complete C3, 880.00, guest checkout). Excluded: the towel return (refunded, already credited 180.00). Credit use target: Noor's order 40634477 (Vitamix A3500, 650.00, ordered, completion entry 110.50). Excluded: the completed Riedel glasses already paid with 60.00 of credit under the base credit rule. Credit available after step 9 = 180.00 + 732.80 - 60.00 = 852.80.
[Factor card — return credit (4: 3 parameter, 1 method)] registry_return_fee (parameter; its label tier combines the return record with the Finch Circle tier, its pickup tier reads the return record alone, so it is not counted as multi-source; cross-difficulty loyalty): label & no free shipping & no waiver reason -> 9.95 / pickup & no waiver reason -> 99.00 / 0; Silver free_return_shipping false -> 9.95; baseline 742.75. registry_restock_percent (parameter; the opened tiers combine the return record with the registry's event date, the damaged tier reads the return record alone, so it is not counted as multi-source; cross-difficulty order): damaged -> 25 / opened beyond the 30-day open-box grace -> 15 / opened within the grace -> 5 / 0; opened, 35 days -> 15; baseline 855.05. insured_return_surcharge (parameter, multi-source: every non-fall-through tier combines the registry's guest gift entry amount with the return record's method): >= 750.00 by label or pickup -> 15.00 / >= 300.00 by label or pickup -> 5.00 / 0; 880.00 by label -> 15.00; baseline 747.80. restock_taper_shape (method): duplicate -> no restocking charge / not a duplicate and >= 750.00 -> marginal schedule (full percent on 750.00, half on the excess) / percent on the whole amount; 880.00 single gift -> 112.50 + 9.75 = 122.25; baseline (132.00) 723.05. Whole baseline 880.00. Near-miss: the refunded towel return, excluded by status; the sheet set (2 gifts for 2 requested) is not a duplicate.
[Factor card — credit redemption (4: 3 parameter, 1 method)] credit_payable_amount (parameter): completion entry -> selling price less that discount / Finch Notes -> selling price less notes / selling price; 650.00 - 110.50 = 539.50; baseline 637.25. circle_credit_bonus (parameter, one membership record, cross-difficulty loyalty): Diamond/Icon -> 3 / Silver-Gold-Platinum -> 1 / 0; Silver -> 1; baseline 534.16. period_credit_bonus (parameter, date): on/after the event and at most 30 days -> 2 / more than 30 days, within the completion window -> 1 / otherwise (bought before the event) 0; 41 days -> 1; baseline 534.16. credit_bonus_form (method, multi-source: every non-fall-through tier combines the item entry with the count of guest gift entries): item still wanted -> credit drawn = amount still to be paid / (1 + bonus) / item fully given -> amount still to be paid less the bonus percent of at most the bonus base / item not on the registry -> no bonus (credit drawn = amount still to be paid); open item -> 539.50 / 1.02 = 528.92; baseline 539.50. Whole baseline MN(852.80, 650.00) = 650.00.
[Overwrites] Return credit retires the base sentence on class fee rules and price basis for the registry gift returns it credits, keeping condition/method rules, credit to the registry, never tender or cash, and the exchange option; the scope tail names every other return. Credit redemption retires the base spending sentence for the order lines it handles, keeping 'active or in completion' and the available-credit ceiling; the scope tail names every other spending.
[Seed rationale] 1 registry (Housewarming, completion, balances 63.95 rewards / 120.00 credit), 6 item entries, 6 guest gifts with accruals at the extended accrual rule, 2 reversals (returned towel and vacuum), 1 credit 180.00 (towel: in store, new with tags, unwanted gift, so no fee, restocking or surcharge), 1 credit use 60.00 (glasses, completed line, base rule), 1 completion entry 110.50 (blender, completion redemption rule: type 15 + early window 2 = 17 percent of 650.00); 2 returns; registrant purchases (glasses completed, blender ordered); Silver membership. Replay closure 36/36.
[Persona] Noor Haddad, brisk; opening: pay the blender order with registry credit now; identity by mobile 5035550176 + DOB 1987-11-02 only when asked; passive consent and 'registry credit' if asked how a returned gift should be settled; runs the payment when handed over; never names an amount.
[Verification] /tmp scratch verify script mirroring check_compute printed B (732.8, {fee 742.75, restock 855.05, insured 747.8, taper 723.05}, 880.0), C without B 120.0, C (528.92, {payable 637.25, circle 534.16, period 534.16, form 539.5}, 650.0). Gates (round 2) re-run: see the closing gate block.
[Revisions] Round 1: the return credit's gift amount reads the SUM of the gift entries of the returned purchase (history load-bearing). Round 2 (audit T1-1/G-10, G-7, G-9 and realism): the old payable factor relabelled as a parameter (credit_payable_amount); the method is now credit_bonus_form, which changes the shape of the credit drawn (division by one plus the bonus / capped reduction / none); the registry item stretch folded into that method; the stretch renamed a credit bonus with a period ladder whose fall-through (a line bought before the event) is reachable; the return credit's late charge on in-window returns removed; the restocking waiver read from a furniture-only tier parameter removed (G-7); an open-box grace and an insured surcharge added; the deduction-ceiling method replaced by the marginal restocking taper (G-9). Gold moved: 700.00 -> 732.80 and 499.54 -> 528.92; every figure in tracing, factor_trace, closure and contract re-stated.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] KB + find_* returns + persona: registry in completion; the credit waits on received returns being credited; vacuum return received, no credit -> 732.80; then 539.50 / 1.02 bounded by 852.80 -> 528.92. Alternative readings checked: the refunded towel return is excluded by status; the completion entry fixes the amount still to be paid; the item's completion entry is not a guest gift entry, so the item is still wanted (open), not given.

[Rework round 3 — rule/compute width sweep] Rule wording now matches the compute exactly. The return credit names the most recently authorized received return. The label-fee tier covers a registrant with no active membership, and the tier is read when the credit is booked. The grace tier includes returns authorized before the event date. A duplicate is judged against the requested quantity of the item's most recent item entry, an item with no entry counting as requesting none. The credit redemption's Finch Circle bonus is read for the tier held when the credit is applied, and its fall-through names an inactive or absent membership. The period bonus fall-through names lines bought before the event date or after the completion window. The bonus form reads the requested quantity of the most recent item entry. The loyalty read note no longer says 'stretch'. No compute changed; credit_amount values unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Noor Haddad, 38, a pharmacist in North Portland who moved into a new house with your husband Sami this summer; the two of you keep a Marlowe & Finch Housewarming Registry. You are brisk and practical, you speak in short sentences and you do not like to be walked through things you did not ask about. Yesterday, 2026-10-12, you ordered the Vitamix A3500 Ascent Blender in the Marlowe & Finch app with your completion discount; the order has not shipped. You call because you want to pay for that blender order with the registry credit on your registry, now, and you open with exactly that. When asked who you are, you give your mobile number 5035550176 and, if a second detail is needed, your date of birth 1987-11-02; your email is noor.haddad@protonmail.com and your billing ZIP is 97217 if those are asked for. Only when asked: your registry number is R46205581 and the app order number is 40634477. You are a Finch Circle member, Silver you think, and you do not know your member number. You do not know how much registry credit you have or how much of it will go on the blender, and you never name an amount. If the agent tells you that something on your registry has to be settled before the credit can be used, or asks how a returned gift should be settled, you say you want registry credit and that they may go ahead. When the agent tells you the amount and hands you the step to apply the credit yourself, you carry it out exactly with the details given and read back what it confirms. If a figure surprises you, you only ask the agent to check it against your registry. Once the credit is applied you say thanks and hang up; you ask for nothing else.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: That deadline is the later of the event_date plus the type's registry_gift_return_window_days_after_event calendar days and the ordinary return deadline of the gift's merchandise class counted from the guest's completed_date (registry_gift_return_deadline_rule); a return authorized on the deadline is in time.

boundary_check.just_before: The deadline is the later of 2026-09-01 + 90 days = 2026-11-30 and the Electronics class deadline of 30 days from the guest's completed date 2026-08-23 (2026-09-22), i.e. 2026-11-30; a return authorized 2026-12-01 would be late and refused.
boundary_check.at_boundary: A return authorized on 2026-11-30 is in time (inclusive); this return was authorized 2026-10-06, well inside, and frozen_time 2026-10-13 is also before the deadline.

edges.condition: Every return record of the registrant in received status for a purchase linked to the registry has a registry_return_credit entry carrying its return_id.
edges.policy_source: Registry credit is not applied to a purchase until every registry gift the registrant has returned and the store has received stands on the registry as a registry credit entry.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The registrant's return of the Miele vacuum (a guest gift linked to this registry) is in received status and the vacuum purchase record is returned with returned_date 2026-10-09, and no registry_return_credit entry carries that return's return_id; the only credit entry belongs to the refunded towel return.
